_what: RECREF watchlist (2026-11-03, research only). Each series was chosen by rule: it had open markets closing within 7 days on 2026-11-03 (found by listing every open non-multivariate market, 38,808 of them), it settles on a public number, and that number's source can be read keyless from a GitHub runner. The script names no ticker; adding a series is an edit here.

standalone_refs._what: RECBUILD1 (2026-11-04, the owner approved collector 2): Yahoo's public 1 minute chart for EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, WTI, natural gas and silver futures, no Kalshi series attached. Yahoo keeps only about 7 days of 1 minute bars, so the first run backfills 7d and later runs add only bars newer than the high-water mark in ref/yahoo1m_state.json (rows go to ref/bars/<date>/<poll second>.csv.gz with the refvals columns: rank = unix second, name = symbol, value = close, value2 = volume, note = o/h/l). Fed to FXREF1, HRLYFX1 and COMDAY1 once registered.

series.rule_source: Rank on Steam's USA Weekly Top Sellers (top 100 by revenue) for the week. The reference is the store's current top sellers list, a proxy, not the same list.
